## Checklist

- [ ] `python tools/lg.py validate` passes
- [ ] Every text field has `de` and `en`
- [ ] No text, tables, structure or mappings from purchased standards, not even paraphrased
- [ ] References point to openly available sources only
- [ ] Nothing claims conformity with a law or standard
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Changes to the meaning of a control or threshold are called out above
